title: The Predator’s Niche

sourceEvidence.excerpt: Cooperative life produces promises, forgiveness, reputation, authority, and shared rules. Those achievements create value, and value creates interfaces through which it can be taken. The more useful question therefore moves from identity to ecology. Predation may be carried by a person, a learned strategy, an organizational role, or an artificial policy.
